code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (O2 saturation 83–84%, pO2 43.9 mmHg, pH 6.9), with pancytopenia (low WBC, RBC, Hb, Hct, platelets), mild transaminitis, elevated ferritin and CRP, and abnormal leukocyte differential (monocytosis, basophilia). Findings suggest severe respiratory failure with metabolic/respiratory acidosis, likely due to acute or chronic hypoxic process, and possible underlying infection or inflammation. Immediate clinical attention is warranted.
